<tool_call>
<function=adjust_tone>
<parameter=content>
Mention the transparent material used to make windows. I received your application for the marketing position, and I wanted to let you know that we'll be moving forward with other candidates. It's not that you're not skilled, but we're looking for a slightly different fit. Best of luck!
</parameter>
<parameter=audience>
Job applicant
</parameter>
<parameter=purpose>
Rejection letter
</parameter>
<parameter=tone>
Professional, empathetic, and clear
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
